case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.body:
Dear Inside Sales,

thank you for your offer.
Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
We would like to work with you on this and can do EUR 4.96 per unit on the attached terms.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we also checked the index change data you cited where it holds and we took it into account, just as we checked the volume change data you cited, which holds and we took it into account as well. 

That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We appreciate your proposal for a 36-month contract and the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause, which allows us to offer a more competitive base price. Please note that our alloy material is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning the recent drop in AS-14404 does not immediately reduce our current costs. Taking into account the verified decrease in PPI-C2431 and the extended contract term, we can offer a revised price of €5.58 per unit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

For our offer, we state a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
